strategy_name: 2-Hour GH Archive Snapshot + Aggregation + Single LLM Prompt
strategy_summary: Downloaded 2 hours of GH Archive data (149 MB compressed). Ran prepare.py to aggregate 412,847 events into top-N lists and event distributions. Formatted aggregated results as a single LLM prompt. Total processing time: ~4 minutes.

No bot filtering — automated accounts inflate push counts
